summary: Makes initial administrator bootstrap safe when multiple API or worker replicas start concurrently against an empty database.
userImpact: A newly deployed multi-replica installation no longer restarts one backend process when two replicas race to create the configured bootstrap administrator.

notes: The fix uses portable TypeORM repository and transaction operations and does not change schemas, migrations, or supported database adapters.

security: Concurrent recovery accepts only the configured active local bootstrap account and still reconciles its canonical authenticated-user and optional platform-administrator memberships transactionally.
Persistence and membership errors remain fatal when no matching concurrent bootstrap winner exists.
documentation: The generated technical release notes describe the replica-safe bootstrap behavior and database-portability contract.
rollback: Redeploy the previous backend image or `@enterpriseglue/shared` package; no database or configuration rollback is required.
validation: The bootstrap unit suite covers the normal first administrator, non-privileged bootstrap, existing administrator reconciliation, a concurrent bootstrap winner, and preservation of genuine persistence failures.
The shared package build and complete backend TypeScript check pass with TypeORM 0.3.31.
